asset_action.description: Allows the model to run an asset action block.
schema: Or: {"action":"project_search","attachment":"attached folder name or selector id","path":".","query":"literal text","offset":0,"limit":100}
Other asset action schemas come from LOADED_SKILLS_CONTENT.
rules: Project actions read the active local source root.
project_tree lists file/folder paths. Start project review with path "." and the default depth; use depth 2..20 only for deliberate drill-down, preferably on a specific subfolder.
project_search searches file contents, not filenames. query is literal text, case-insensitive.

offset is the number of results to skip (default 0). limit is the maximum number of returned paths or matching lines (default 100, allowed 1..200). For a next page, use the returned offset and keep the other inputs unchanged. A larger limit or offset does not extend the scan.
To inspect a file copy the returned folder-rooted path into ATTACH_FILE_CONTENT, optionally with #Lstart-Lend for example L1-L101.
